name: io.github.Servosity/unifi-network-mcp
title: UniFi MCP
description: Every UniFi Network API operation, plus drift detection, topology, and rule prediction no other

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the UNIFI_API_KEY credential for the UniFi MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_BASE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path segment appended to the gateway host, when your controller does not serve the Network API at the standard location. Leave blank for a stock UniFi OS gateway.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL, e.g. https://10.0.0.1/proxy/network. Leave blank when you set the gateway host above; the CLI builds this from it.

environmentVariables.name: UNIFI_GATEWAY_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Set the UNIFI_GATEWAY_HOST credential for the UniFi MCP server.
